  "memo":"R01 holds; Account access is the only adverse family. No other rule holds, no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Row §6.6(b) therefore applies, with contact as the sole required check. Contact passed, so §5.3(a) requires clear and prohibits further adverse dispositions. A legitimate new device and password reset are the strongest benign explanation. The isolated AVS failure lacks R03's country mismatch and cannot independently support action. The order has already shipped. No additional check is required."
